body.statement: For every admissible compact family \(\mathcal K\), the bounded-Lipschitz distance, uniformly over \(Q\in\mathcal K\), between the \(P_{N,Q}\)-law of \[\sqrt N\left([\widehat\beta-\beta_0]_Q,[\widehat\sigma^2-\sigma^2]_Q,[\widehat\tau^2-\tau^2]_Q,[\widehat P_{0X}]_Q-P_{0X,Q}\right)\] and the law of \([\mathcal A_T\mathbb Z_T^{\mathrm{full}}]_Q=([LZ_m]_Q,[A_v\{Z_v-\sigma^2Q_\beta LZ_m\}]_Q,[\mathbb G_{0X}]_Q)\) on \(\mathcal F_{0X,T}\) tends to zero.
body.justification: This law propagates same-panel residual dependence to every fitted input of the counterfactual recursion.
body.gap: Causal-MP gives consistency, not the same-sample variance-score correction in this expansion.
body.consumer: The public estimator obtains a joint covariance for its fitted structural inputs.
